publicExplanation: 瓦解冰消 means collapse and melt away. Yuanwu Keqin says Huanglong Huinan's unresolved point dissolved when he investigated Xuansha's words; Miyun Yuanwu says doubts disappear on arriving and seeing directly. Zhongfeng Mingben applies the image to the collapse of inherited patriarchal forms. Yunmen Wenyan uses the terse phrase directly upon a monk's entrance, leaving its target to the encounter.
